BILL NUMBER:  S3423

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the social services law, in relation to allowing child
care providers to opt out of providing certain personal information
online


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
To allow child care providers to not allow certain personal
information to be provided online.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
This legislation amends section 390 of the social services law by
adding a new subdivision 8-a.  The new subdivision makes it unlawful
for the Office of Children and Family Services to give a child care
provider's street address and map showing the location of their home
online without allowing the provider to opt out of the online posting
of this information.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Child care providers have expressed safety and security concerns about
the Office of Children and Family Services' website, which posts
addresses and a map link to providers' homes. This legislation gives
providers the option to not have this information displayed.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New Bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
In sixty days.
